name: Runcan
source:
The knight of Runan, or Runcan of Runan, is a self proclaimed knight from the Runan province. He is actually a criminal who kidnap women to create the world's biggest harem.

He assaults Santa's workshop with Rickey and Boyardee. He has a grudge against Santa, seeking revenge against the old man.

[Edited from in-game description]
